meta.title: The data problems, and what was done about each

network_outage.action: Missing, not zero, for every feature and fit; the day and the days that read it are out of every score.

closed_docks.definition: A day or more with no departures and no returns at a dock that normally logs at least 30 trips over that stretch.
events_that_line_up: Hyde Park docks, late Nov to early Dec 2024
Notting Hill Carnival weekends, Aug 2024 and Aug 2025
New Year at Waterloo and Westminster Pier
closed_docks.action: Missing, not zero, for the model fits and out of every score.

suspect_empty_hours.definition: No departures in an hour whose same hour averaged six or more over the four weeks either side. A true zero at that mean has a 0.25% chance.
suspect_empty_hours.effect: Setting them aside moves the count model's mean pinball from 0.375 to 0.371. It is a floor: a dock empty for 20 minutes still logs trips.

other: Trips taken are not trips wanted. An empty dock records no demand, and the archive has no dock availability.
School terms for 2024/25 are not on the live council lists, so they were compiled by hand from five borough calendars. The flag turned out to add nothing.
Station numbers are not fixed places and some files lose leading zeros. Numbers are padded and matched by name.
Forecast weather is the ECMWF run Open-Meteo stored for that morning, not what actually happened. Four mornings in August 2025 are missing.
